IDS.name: magnetics
IDS.documentation: Magnetic diagnostics for equilibrium identification and plasma shape control.

field.name: ids_properties
field.documentation: Interface Data Structure properties. This element identifies the node above as an IDS

field.name: comment
field.documentation: Any comment describing the content of this IDS

field.name: name
field.documentation: User-defined name for this IDS occurrence

field.name: homogeneous_time
field.documentation: This node must be filled (with 0, 1, or 2) for the IDS to be valid. If 1, the time of this IDS is homogeneous, i.e. the time values for this IDS are stored in the time node just below the root of this IDS. If 0, the time values are stored in the various time fields at lower levels in the tree. In the case only constant or static nodes are filled within the IDS, homogeneous_time must be set to 2

field.name: occurrence_type
field.documentation: Type of data contained in this occurrence

field.name: index
field.documentation: Integer identifier (enumeration index within a list). Private identifier values must be indicated by a negative index.

field.name: provider

field.documentation: Date at which this data has been produced

field.name: node
field.documentation: Set of IDS nodes for which the provenance is given. The provenance information applies to the whole structure below the IDS node. For documenting provenance information for the whole IDS, set the size of this array of structure to 1 and leave the child "path" node empty

field.name: path
field.documentation: Path of the node within the IDS, following the syntax given in the link below. If empty, means the provenance information applies to the whole IDS.

field.name: reference
field.documentation: List of references used to populate or calculate this node, identified as explained below. In case the node is the result of of a calculation / data processing, the reference is an input to the process described in the "code" structure at the root of the IDS. The reference can be an IDS (identified by a URI or a persitent identifier, see syntax in the link below) or non-IDS data imported directly from an non-IMAS database (identified by the command used to import the reference, or the persistent identifier of the data reference). Often data are obtained by a chain of processes, however only the last process input are recorded here. The full chain of provenance has then to be reconstructed recursively from the provenance information contained in the data references.

field.name: timestamp
field.documentation: Date and time (UTC) at which the reference was created, expressed in a human readable form (ISO 8601) : the format of the string shall be : YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. Example : 2020-07-24T14:19:00Z

field.name: flux_loop
field.documentation: Flux loops; partial flux loops can be described

field.name: name
field.documentation: Short string identifier (unique for a given device)

field.name: description
field.documentation: Description, e.g. “channel viewing the upper divertor”

field.name: index
field.documentation: Integer identifier (enumeration index within a list). Private identifier values must be indicated by a negative index.

field.name: position
field.documentation: List of (R,Z,phi) points defining the position of the loop (see data structure documentation FLUXLOOPposition.pdf)

field.name: phi
field.documentation: Toroidal angle (oriented counter-clockwise when viewing from above)

field.name: indices_differential
field.documentation: Indices (from the flux_loop array of structure) of the two flux loops used to build the flux difference flux(second index) - flux(first index). Use only if ../type/index = 6, leave empty otherwise

field.name: area
field.documentation: Effective area (ratio between flux and average magnetic field over the loop)

field.name: gm9
field.documentation: Integral of 1/R over the loop area (ratio between flux and magnetic rigidity R0.B0). Use only if ../type/index = 3 to 6, leave empty otherwise.

field.name: flux
field.documentation: Measured magnetic flux through loop with normal to enclosed surface determined by order of points

field.name: validity_timed
field.documentation: Indicator of the validity of the data for each time slice. 0: valid from automated processing, 1: valid and certified by the diagnostic RO; - 1 means problem identified in the data processing (request verification by the diagnostic RO), -2: invalid data, should not be used (values lower than -2 have a code-specific meaning detailing the origin of their invalidity)

field.name: position
field.documentation: R, Z, Phi position of the coil centre

field.name: phi
field.documentation: Toroidal angle (oriented counter-clockwise when viewing from above)

field.name: poloidal_angle
field.documentation: Angle of the sensor normal vector (vector parallel to the the axis of the coil, n on the diagram) with respect to horizontal plane (clockwise theta-like angle). Zero if sensor normal vector fully in the horizontal plane and oriented towards increasing major radius. Values in [0 , 2Pi]

field.name: toroidal_angle
field.documentation: Angle of the projection of the sensor normal vector (n) in the horizontal plane with the increasing R direction (i.e. grad(R)) (angle is counter-clockwise from above). Values should be taken modulo pi with values within (-pi/2,pi/2]. Zero if projected sensor normal is parallel to grad(R), pi/2 if it is parallel to grad(phi).

field.name: indices_differential
field.documentation: Indices (from the b_field_pol_probe array of structure) of the two probes used to build the field difference field(second index) - field(first index). Use only if ../type/index = 6, leave empty otherwise

field.name: bandwidth_3db
field.documentation: 3dB bandwith (first index : lower frequency bound, second index : upper frequency bound)

field.name: area
field.documentation: Area of each turn of the sensor; becomes effective area when multiplied by the turns

field.name: length
field.documentation: Length of the sensor along it's normal vector (n)

field.name: turns
field.documentation: Turns in the coil, including sign

field.name: field
field.documentation: Magnetic field component in direction of sensor normal axis (n) averaged over sensor volume defined by area and length, where n = cos(poloidal_angle)*cos(toroidal_angle)*grad(R) - sin(poloidal_angle)*grad(Z) + cos(poloidal_angle)*sin(toroidal_angle)*grad(Phi)/norm(grad(Phi))

field.name: validity_timed
field.documentation: Indicator of the validity of the data for each time slice. 0: valid from automated processing, 1: valid and certified by the diagnostic RO; - 1 means problem identified in the data processing (request verification by the diagnostic RO), -2: invalid data, should not be used (values lower than -2 have a code-specific meaning detailing the origin of their invalidity)

field.documentation: Non-linear response of the probe (typically in case of a Hall probe)

field.name: b_field_linear
field.documentation: Array of magnetic field values (corresponding to the assumption of a linear relation between magnetic field and probe coil current), for each of which the probe non-linear response is given in ../b_field_non_linear

field.name: b_field_non_linear
field.documentation: Magnetic field value taking into account the non-linear response of the probe

field.name: b_field_pol_probe_equivalent
field.documentation: Indices of equivalent poloidal field probes (from the b_field_pol_probe array) that differ only by their toroidal position and have the same (R,Z) position and the same coil orientation (poloidal and toroidal angles). Sets of equivalent probes (i.e. sets of (R, Z, poloidal_angle and toroidal_angle) values) are grouped by the first coordinate and the coils belonging to a given set are listed along the second coordinate. As an example, if there are N probes in a poloidal cross section that are replicated at the same poloidal positions and with the same orientation at 8 toroidal positions, the matrix will be of size Nx8.

field.name: rogowski_coil
field.documentation: Set of Rogowski coils. If some of the coils form a compound Rogowski sensor, they must be entered in contiguous order

field.name: name
field.documentation: Short string identifier (unique for a given device)

field.name: description
field.documentation: Description, e.g. “channel viewing the upper divertor”

field.name: index
field.documentation: Integer identifier (enumeration index within a list). Private identifier values must be indicated by a negative index.

field.name: position
field.documentation: List of (R,Z,phi) points defining the position of the coil guiding centre. Values defining a single segment must be entered in contiguous order

field.name: phi
field.documentation: Toroidal angle (oriented counter-clockwise when viewing from above)

field.name: indices_compound
field.documentation: Indices (from the rogowski_coil array of structure) of the partial Rogowskis used to build the coumpound signal (sum of the partial Rogowski signals). Can be set to any unique integer value for each section of a compound Rogowski coil. Use only if ../measure_quantity/index = 5, leave empty otherwise

field.name: area
field.documentation: Effective area of the loop wrapped around the guiding centre. In case of multiple layers, sum of the areas of each layer

field.name: turns_per_metre
field.documentation: Number of turns per unit length. In case of multiple layers, turns are counted for a single layer

field.name: current
field.documentation: Measured current inside the Rogowski coil contour. The normal direction to the Rogowski coil is defined by the order of points in the list of guiding centre positions. The current is positive when oriented in the same direction as the normal.

field.documentation: Set of shunt resistances through which currents in the divertor structure are measured. Shunts are modelled as piecewise straight line segments in the poloidal plane.

field.name: ip
field.documentation: Plasma current. Positive sign means anti-clockwise when viewed from above. The array of structure corresponds to a set of calculation methods (starting with the generally recommended method).
